property_summary: After any sequence of play() calls, the balance of the C contract (address(c).balance) is always greater than or equal to pot, with equality holding when no transfer has occurred since the last win; the buggy version adds an extra wei per call to pot without adding it to the contract's balance, so eventually address(c).balance < pot.
change_summary: Replace 'pot += msg.value;' with 'pot += msg.value + 1;' so pot accumulates an extra 1 wei per play call.
